name: aerojet-careers
description: Aerojet Aviation Careers Portal — Job listings, applications, admin dashboard
//ajv-note: No `ajv` override on purpose. @eslint/eslintrc requires ajv v6 (it passes the v6-only `missingRefs` option and expects the v6 CJS export shape), so forcing v8 crashes every `eslint` run with "Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'defaultMeta')". Scoped overrides/resolutions did not stick: Bun kept the hoisted v8. The advisory (ReDoS via the `$data` option, >=7.0.0-alpha.0 <8.18.0) does not affect v6, and the vulnerable v8 copy is pulled only by @vercel/static-config, a dev-only deploy tool that never ships. Left to normal resolution: eslintrc keeps v6, everything else gets v8.
//path-to-regexp-undici-note: Not overridden on purpose. Both live only in the `vercel` CLI tree (dev-only deploy tooling) and `jsdom` (tests), and both exist at several majors at once: path-to-regexp at 6.1.0/6.3.0/8.2.0/8.3.0 (needs >=6.3.0 for the 6.x line and >=8.4.0 for the 8.x line) and undici from 5.28.4 up to 7.29.0 (clearing every advisory would require every copy to be >=6.28.0, i.e. a major bump inside the CLI). A single flat override cannot express per-major targets, and Bun ignored nested/scoped overrides here, so forcing one version would break the CLI for no production benefit. `vercel` is already pinned to the latest (59.4.0).
